response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced Staff/Senior Software Engineer with over 15 years of industry experience, making him drastically overqualified for an entry-level Junior Java Developer position. His core expertise lies in JavaScript/TypeScript, DLang, and full-stack web development rather than Java, and his German proficiency is listed as only 'Basic', falling short of the strong verbal and written German required for client-facing insurance consulting work.
strengths: Extensive, proven software engineering experience across web, mobile, and backend systems
Strong familiarity with agile practices, TDD, CI/CD, and modern cloud-adjacent tooling
Demonstrated leadership, mentoring, and public speaking/workshop experience
concerns: Severely overqualified for an entry-level/junior role, raising retention and salary-fit concerns
German language skill listed as 'Basic', not meeting the strong communication requirement for client-facing insurance projects
Limited recent hands-on Java experience; primary stack is JS/TypeScript and DLang, not Java
